rules: Transient Mobile UI Bridge proposal; never dispatchTool or persistence.
Session identity and proposal UUID are application-owned, absent from model arguments.
Callback acknowledges rendered review, not confirmation or storage.
Only explicit patient approval submits ConfirmedInsightCreate; rejection makes no API write.
Never infer diagnoses, treatment effects, suicidality scores, or clinician monitoring.

tools.name: propose_conversation_insight
tools.description: Offer a short neutral note grounded in a specific patient statement for review, edit or rejection. Does not save anything. Use patient_approved_interpretation for an interpretation, never a medical conclusion.

observed_at.description: When the patient reported the experience. Ask if unclear; never invent a date.

tools.name: propose_assessment_answer
tools.description: While the patient is answering a questionnaire shown on screen, highlight the answer option that matches what they said. Saves nothing: the patient taps an option to answer.

question_id.description: The question_id of the question currently on screen.

value.description: The option value that matches the patient's words.

tools.name: open_assessment
tools.description: Show the questionnaire the patient asked for on screen (phq9 about 3 minutes, extended about 8 minutes). The patient can stop at any time; nothing is saved until every question is answered.

assessment.description: phq9 for the short questionnaire, extended for the longer one.
